passthrough.reason: fuser 0.15.1 exposes no FUSE_PASSTHROUGH init flag, no FUSE_DEV_IOC_BACKING_OPEN ioctl, and no per-inode backing id. FUSE passthrough landed in FUSE ABI 7.40 (Linux 6.9+); fuser 0.15.1 tops out at abi-7-31. Enabling it needs a newer fuser (a new dependency) or unsafe ioctl FFI outside the sanctioned src/async_io.rs, so it is out of scope here.
passthrough.ekb_is_not_a_valid_backing_file: a .ekb generation has headers/core before the tile blob, so file offset != logical offset

io_uring_fuse.reason: fuser 0.15.1 does not negotiate FUSE-over-io_uring (the FUSE_HAS_IO_URING init flag and per-queue uring setup added in Linux 6.14+); no API is exposed, so the mount uses the classic /dev/fuse request loop.

window_read.name: fuse window (persistent fd, warm page cache)
fuse window (open per read, uncached FUSE request)

verdict: FUSE adds no measurable overhead over the direct read of a materialised object: a full 2.0 MiB read costs 3721 us through FUSE vs 4229 us direct (both are the EKBLOOM decode, ~146x the 29.0 us raw-file read). Per uncached 4 KiB request FUSE adds 13.8 us over the direct handle (20.8 us vs 6.9 us; the /dev/fuse round trip plus open); a persistent handle is served from the kernel page cache at 0.5 us p50, and the raw file at 0.2 us. Passthrough is NOT available through fuser 0.15.1.
